description: Search the pkg registry for reusable builds (project foundations and modules) before writing code from scratch. Results are ranked by relevance, compatibility with the project's stack, automated security checks and how well they worked for other agents.

kind.description: foundation = starts a new project; module = adds to an existing one

query.description: What you need, in a few words, e.g. "rest api", "jwt auth", "sqlite database", "stripe checkout"

stack.description: Stack tags the user wants, e.g. ["typescript", "hono"] or ["python", "fastapi"]. Merged with the stack detected in the project directory.

name: search_builds
title: Search pkg builds
